title: Sports Physical Packet Form
subtitle: Capture packet source, examination reference, signature status, and restriction; confirm submission date and roster clearance.
description: Sports Physical Packet records packet source, examination reference, signature status, restriction, submission date, and roster clearance. Sports Physical Packet evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this sports physical packet operational record when staff must document packet source and examination reference. Reconcile signature status, restriction, submission date, and roster clearance before the sports physical packet handoff. Use the packet checklist, examination reference, required signatures, restriction insert, submission receipt, missing-page request, review stamp, and roster eligibility update. This packet centers document completeness: examination page, clinician signature, restriction attachment, parent page, school receipt, missing-page chase, review stamp, and roster release. Ask the assigned sports physical packet reviewer to confirm packet source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Sports Physical Packet starting details
sections.guidance: Track examination reference, required packet pages, qualified signatures, restriction sheet, submission date, missing document, and roster clearance. Keep any urgent sports physical packet issue with its escalation contact and time.
